# Bare-name stems that occur in >=2 Bundeslaender in the Destatis
# municipality list. The labeller MUST refuse to guess a Land from a
# bare stem in this set (fall back to PLZ or an exact normalized_name
# match instead). One stem per line, sorted, generated by
# tools/build_geo_table.py — do not hand-edit.
#
# NOTE: if this list contains a blank line, that line represents the
# empty-string stem shared by >=2 Laender' municipalities whose full
# name IS a bare preposition ("Am Mellensee", "An der Poststrasse", ...
# -- QUALIFIER_RE consumes the entire name, not just a suffix, when the
# name itself starts with the preposition). It is inert by design: any
# reader of this file (including pflege_jobs.geo._load) treats a blank
# line as "no stem", and geo.resolve() never looks up an empty stem in
# the first place (it gates on `if stem:` before consulting this set) --
# those municipalities are already handled correctly one branch earlier,
# via an exact normalized_name match. Do not skip it as a stray newline.
